_comment_publicBaseUrl: Set this only if you watch from another device. It must be an address that device can reach, not localhost.
_comment_accessToken: Required to reach this server from anywhere but the machine it runs on; it becomes the first path segment of the addon URL. Empty means no authentication at all. Generate one with: node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(24).toString('base64url'))"
_comment_trustedHosts: Host header values besides loopback allowed to reach the channel editor, such as 192.168.1.58:7654. Only consulted once accessToken is set.
_comment_linkKeeper: Debrid links expire, so the server tops them up ahead of time. 'watched' only does that for channels playing now or watched within linkKeeperGraceMinutes, which keeps a large lineup from spending your debrid rate limit on channels nobody opens; a cold channel resolves on demand and takes a few seconds to start. Use 'all' to prepare every channel.
_comment_encoder: auto | nvenc | qsv | vaapi | cpu. Leave on auto unless detection picks wrong.
_comment_resolver: Two options. Direct TorBox: set torboxApiKey (indexerUrl supplies torrent hashes, default Torrentio needs no config). Or any debrid: set streamAddonUrl to a stream addon install URL that already has your debrid key. TorBox wins if both are set.
_comment_smart: Optional keys for smart channels. Basic Cinemeta rules need none. TMDB accepts an API Read Access Token (preferred) or v3 API Key; imports use their respective credentials.
